title: Réti Opening: the ideas
line: The knight goes first, a side pawn attacks the center, and both bishops aim at it from the side.

steps.text: Bring the knight out first. It watches the center and keeps your choices open.

also.e2e4: That is the most played first move, the king pawn opening. This lesson starts with the knight.
also.d2d4: That is the queen pawn opening, also sound. This lesson starts with the knight.
also.c2c4: That is the English Opening, also sound. This lesson starts with the knight.

steps.after: Black takes the center with its queen pawn.

steps.text: Push the pawn on c2 two squares. It attacks the center pawn from the side.

also.d2d4: That is a queen pawn game, also sound. This lesson attacks the center pawn from the side.
also.g2g3: That is the King's Indian Attack, also sound. This lesson attacks the center pawn from the side.

steps.after: This is the Réti Opening. Black guards the center pawn with another pawn.

steps.text: Move the pawn on b2 one square. It guards the pawn on c4 and opens a long diagonal for a bishop.
Move the pawn on g2 one square. It opens the other long diagonal.
Put the bishop on the long diagonal. Your king will castle behind it.
Put the other bishop on its long diagonal. It aims at the center squares d4 and e5.
Castle. Your king is safe behind the bishop on g2.
steps.after: White has no pawn in the center yet, but its knight and the bishop on b2 watch it.

summary: White fights for the center from the side: a knight, a side pawn and two bishops on the long diagonals.
